# gif-studio

> AI-first studio that turns any repo, running app, folder of images or brief into looping GIF, MP4 and still
> marketing assets. Agents drive it through a CLI (`npx gif-studio … --json`) or a local stdio MCP server
> (`npx gif-studio mcp`); humans review in a browser studio with scrubbing, pinned notes, versions and pacing.

Start with `npx gif-studio guide` (the full agent playbook) and `npx gif-studio status --json`.

## Docs

- [Agent playbook](AGENTS.md): the loop (scan → explore → journeys → record → new → preview → render → studio →
  apply notes → promote), scene contract, runtime API, journey format, quality bar
- [README](README.md): install, quick start, commands, MCP setup, configuration
- [Agent skill](skill/SKILL.md): short procedure installed into `.cursor/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.agents/skills`

## Key facts

- Every CLI command accepts `--json` and returns `{ok, data, summary, next}`; errors return `{ok: false, error, hint}`.
- MCP tools mirror CLI commands: guide, status, init, templates, scan, app_start/stop/status, auth_login,
  browser_open/click/type/press/hover/scroll/screenshot/snapshot, explore, journeys_list/save, record, asset_new,
  media_add, scene_preview, render, studio_start, notes, note_done, pacing, promote.
- Scene contract: `window.__scene = {contract: 1, width, height, duration, sections, beats, seek(t), ready}`;
  scenes are pure functions of time.
- Output layout: `marketing/gifs/<asset>/{brief.md, scene.html, versions/, final/, archive/}`, captures in
  `marketing/gifs/captures/<journey>/`.
